svg.title: Asimov v1 assurance lifecycle
svg.desc: The seven phases P0 to P6, each closed by its gate: G0 Governance; G1 Concept; G2 System design; G3 HW/SW development; G4 Integration and verification; G5 Validation and release; G6 Operation. Today is P1; the gates before it are passed by their records. Hold points at G1 and G4.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Seven phases, seven gates, none passed

svg.text: Hold points: G1: no powered floor test before the gantry, the wired E-stop and WP-V-07; G4: no person within reach before WP-V-03 passes.

svg.text: A gate counts as passed only when its record in 10-safety-case/gates/ says Pass. Gate skeletons are generated by the process model.
